responsibility: Define the Line and Station data shapes used to represent tube reference data across the backend.
non_responsibilities: Load or index station/line data from the JSON data files
Fetch or represent live arrival data

public_interface.name: derive_code
public_interface.description: Compute a station's 3-letter code from its station id and name, applying the NIE/BPS naming exceptions for Nine Elms and Battersea Power Station.
preconditions: station_id is a valid 940GZZLUXXX-style station id
postconditions: Returns 'NIE' when station_name is Nine Elms and 'BPS' when station_name is Battersea Power Station
Returns the last 3 letters of station_id, uppercased, for all other stations

responsibility: Define the ArrivalBoard and ArrivalBoardEntry data shapes used to represent a formatted, direction-grouped arrival board.
non_responsibilities: Fetch raw arrival data from the TfL API
Filter, merge, sort, or format raw arrivals into these shapes

public_interface.name: format_time_display
public_interface.description: Format a time-to-station value in seconds into the ArrivalBoardEntry.time_display string ('Due' under 30 seconds, otherwise 'X min' rounded to the nearest minute).
postconditions: Returns 'Due' when seconds_to_station < 30
Otherwise returns seconds_to_station rounded to the nearest minute, suffixed with ' min'

responsibility: Load the tube station and line reference data from the bundled JSON files and provide lookup and search operations over it.
non_responsibilities: Implement the 3-letter station code derivation rule directly (delegates to app.models.station.derive_code)

public_interface.name: search_stations
public_interface.description: Return stations whose name contains the query (case-insensitive) or whose derived 3-letter code exactly matches the query.
postconditions: Results are drawn only from the 272 bundled stations
An empty list is returned when no station matches
Code matching uses app.models.station.derive_code for each candidate station

public_interface.name: get_station
public_interface.description: Return the station with the given id, including the full list of lines it is served by, computing its 3-letter code (using the NIE/BPS exceptions for Nine Elms and Battersea Power Station).
postconditions: Returns None when station_id is not one of the 272 bundled stations
The returned Station's code field is computed via app.models.station.derive_code

responsibility: Fetch arrival predictions for a single tube line from the TfL Unified API.
non_responsibilities: Filter arrivals to a specific station
Merge, sort, or format arrivals for display

public_interface.name: get_arrivals
public_interface.description: Call GET https://api.tfl.gov.uk/Line/{line_id}/Arrivals/ and return the parsed list of arrival predictions for that line.
preconditions: line_id is one of the 11 supported tube line ids
postconditions: Returns all in-progress predictions reported by TfL for the line, unfiltered by station
Raises a client error if the TfL API request fails

responsibility: Interpret a raw TfL platform name string into a canonical board direction and a platform number.

public_interface.name: parse
public_interface.description: Extract the direction (Northbound/Eastbound/Southbound/Westbound) and platform number from a raw TfL platformName string.
postconditions: direction is None when none of the four canonical directions appear in the string
platform_number is None when no platform digit can be identified

responsibility: Produce the direction-grouped arrival boards for a station on a specific line, merging same-train entries across platforms.
non_responsibilities: Perform HTTP calls to the TfL API directly
Load or search station reference data
Implement the time-to-display-string formatting rule directly (delegates to app.models.arrival.format_time_display)

public_interface.name: get_arrival_boards
public_interface.description: Fetch arrivals for line_id, keep only those at station_id, merge entries sharing a vehicle id within the same direction across platforms, and return one sorted, indexed board per direction present in the data.
preconditions: station_id refers to a known station
line_id is one of the lines that station is served by
postconditions: Arrivals sharing the same vehicle id within the same direction are merged into one entry with a comma-joined, sorted list of platform numbers ('-' when none are identifiable)
Each board's entries are sorted ascending by arrival time and indexed starting at 1
Entries whose direction cannot be determined are omitted from any board
Time display for each entry is produced via app.models.arrival.format_time_display
Raises a domain error when station_id is unknown or line_id is not served by the station

responsibility: Expose the HTTP endpoint for searching tube stations by name or 3-letter code.

public_interface.name: search_stations
public_interface.description: GET /api/stations/search?q= — delegate to the station repository and return matching stations as JSON.
postconditions: Returns an empty JSON array when no station matches

responsibility: Expose the HTTP endpoint for retrieving arrival boards for a station on a specific line.
non_responsibilities: Fetch, filter, merge or format arrival data itself

public_interface.name: get_arrivals
public_interface.description: GET /api/arrivals?station_id=&line_id= — delegate to the arrival service and return the resulting boards as JSON.
postconditions: Responds 404 when station_id is unknown
Responds 400 when line_id is not served by station_id
Responds 200 with the boards otherwise

responsibility: Construct and configure the FastAPI application, wiring routers and cross-origin settings.

public_interface.name: create_app
public_interface.description: Build the FastAPI app, register the stations and arrivals routers, and configure CORS for the frontend origin.
postconditions: The returned app has the stations and arrivals routers mounted under /api
